title: An aspect or fabric can add child aspects only to declarations contained in its target type or namespace.
rationale: The title says 'only under its target declaration', which is incorrect for member-level aspects: Query.InvokeAsync compares the child with the closest named type of the originating declaration (or its namespace), so an aspect on a method can add child aspects to other members of the same type. The message is correct because '{2}' is that computed container. Note: LAMA0039 (IneligibleChildAspect) reuses this title although it is about eligibility; it should get its own title.
